import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpl0d1-u1-ceiling/frozen/seen-2/play/users/u028/system/state/workspace/primitives")
from arc_dsl import *
import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def transform(grid):
    grid=[list(r) for r in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # dot = isolated single non-bg cells; template = contiguous run of non-bg cells with length>1
    runs=[]
    dots=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        j=0
        while j<w:
            if row[j]!=bg:
                k=j
                while k<w and row[k]!=bg: k+=1
                if k-j>1: runs.append((i,j,k-j))
                else: dots.append((i,j))
                j=k
            else: j+=1
    # dot color = the isolated cell color (scattered)
    dotcolor=grid[dots[0][0]][dots[0][1]]
    ti,tj,tl=runs[0]
    tpl=[grid[ti][tj+x] for x in range(tl)]
    off=tl//2
    for i,j in dots:
        if (i,j)==(ti,tj): continue
        s=j-off
        for x in range(tl):
            if 0<=s+x<w: grid[i][s+x]=tpl[x]
    return grid

demo_i=G['Demo pair 1 input']; demo_o=G['Demo pair 1 output']
out=transform(demo_i)
print(out==demo_o)
